result.instructions: Tools for IPDetective, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Check my IPDetective request and lookup allowance."; "Investigate 8.8.8.8 for bot, datacenter and ASN signals."; "Check this list of IP addresses after I confirm the allowance usage.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes IPDetective data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run ipdetective_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run ipdetective_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run ipdetective_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. ipdetective_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: ipdetective_account_usage
tools.title: Check IPDetective allowance
tools.description: Read account request and lookup limits and current usage. Does not look up an IP address.

tools.name: ipdetective_lookup_ip
tools.title: Investigate an IP address
tools.description: Look up a public IPv4 or IPv6 address for IPDetective's bot signal and optional datacenter, VPN/proxy, ASN and country information. Uses your vendor allowance. This is a risk signal, not proof of abuse. No automatic retries.

tools.name: ipdetective_lookup_batch
tools.title: Investigate a batch of IP addresses
tools.description: Look up 1–100 public IP addresses in one vendor request. Requires confirm:true because it consumes your IPDetective allowance. Duplicates are removed before submission. No automatic retries or background polling; check usage before resubmitting after an error.
